title: "Free Breeze"
subtitle: Ahh, the sea breeze, the freedom, and the last day of vacation, already slipping away.

trails.title: Performance Review
trails.description: Please make sure she completes this document in person.

content.text:
Codename: Regulus
Time Employed: 11 months
Project Team: The "Storm" Research Group (Unregistered)
Assessment Results: Not available

Performance Review:

Research on the Influence of Light and Sound Waves on Emotion Control on Crowds.

Safety Verification of St. Pavlov Foundation's Communication Equipment.

Exploration of the Possibility of Communication without Numbers with the School of Apeiron.

No accomplishments.

Probationary Experience:

Assisted the Timekeeper in investigating the "Storm," consistently on the front lines of responding to the "Storm," and have experienced three "Storms." These experiences provided invaluable data for Laplace's "Storm" research. During this operation, her numerous active contributions have brought a wealth of inspiration to colleagues. In interactions with the St. Pavlov Foundation and the School of Apeiron, she has displayed outstanding negotiation skills, making her a crucial and mainstay member of the Timekeeper squad. ██████████████████████████████████████████████

Evaluator's Comments:

Alright, enough with the charade. The only thing in this document that she actually provided herself is this photo! I'll let her join the research group as a formal researcher, but she will not receive any benefits until she personally fills in all the blanks on this form.

—Ulrich

items.text: Street, Sydney Harbour

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, we seem to have deviated from our route to Laplace.
The road to the LSCC is ever fraught with obstacles.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: A great pirate, Mr. APPLe, doesn't simply rely on her compass. She must listen to her heart, too!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ah. This APPLe thought you were trying to slip away to make the most of your final day off.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahem. Well, that too.
Like Odysseus returning victorious from the Trojan War, Regulus nimbly dives into one vortex after another.

items.speaker: Street Vendor
items.text: Come get your Succarath whiskers all the way from Brazil, perfect for brewing a Chillwind Elixir! Only 185 Sharpodonties!

items.speaker: Street Vendor
items.text: See anything you like? You won't find a better price anywhere!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa, this is a good price! Do you have more of this stuff? Show me everything you've got!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, might I remind you that Ms. Sotheby is not traveling with us at this time?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, yeah. You're right.
The temptations before them seem to be endless.
A street artist sings as paint flies through the air, almost splashing onto Regulus's sunglasses.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Alright, mate? Whoa, love the colors! How about bringing in some pop art? Trust me, it'll take it to a whole new level.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You should come visit London sometime! We've got some seriously groovy art on the streets.

items.speaker: Street Artist
items.text: Pop art? That's a bit dated, don't you think?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I beg your pardon?!
Just as Regulus rolls up her sleeves, ready for a tussle, a not-too-distant cheer grabs her attention.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Did you hear that? We'd better go over there and check it out, Mr. APPLe.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: What is it? Could it be Manus Vindictae?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Vertin did caution us against the Manus followers we might encounter in Australia.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No, it's something much more important than that!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Ladies and gentlemen! Welcome to the greatest sailaway party in all Australia!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: For those of you who haven't signed up for the trip, think again! This is the ultimate sailing experience—relaxation, food, drink, and music! Don't miss out!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: The "Free Breeze" is about to set sail!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: No need to worry about currency exchange! Whether it's Australian dollars, Sharpodonties, arcane materials, or a rare collectible item—all are welcome in exchange for a ticket of equal value!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: A small price to pay for an unforgettable journey with the talented multi-instrumentalist Barcarola and her fantastic Crackling Box!
The cheers grow louder and louder.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: We've also prepared a little gift for our most enthusiastic guest:

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: A free cruise ticket!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: That's what I'm talking about!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: *sigh* This APPLe should have known better.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Ladies and gentlemen, the party starts now! Put your hands together for the enchanting Ms. Barcarola and her captivating melodies!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Woo-hoo!
Compliments gush from the ticket seller's mouth as the star at the center of the stage subtly turns her face away.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: You're much too kind, Mr. Hamish, saying all these wonderful things about me, but I'm only a cruise musician.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: It's thanks to the collective efforts of the whole crew that the "Free Breeze" has been so successful. I just feel privileged to be a part of it.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: I know you want to stay humble, Ms. Barcarola, but there's no reason to be so modest!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Many of our guests come aboard just to hear you play, and I'm sure there will only be more in the future! So, what's the harm with hyping the crowd up with a little round of applause?

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Well, if it's for the ship, I suppose I can handle a little publicity.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Of course you can! And you deserve it, too! By the way, do you know the guest over there? She's very, uh, enthusiastic.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Hm?
She follows the direction he's pointing to find a particularly lively duo among the crowd.
A girl dressed in red and blue, and a floating apple.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: She's been drumming up the crowd—sold us a load more tickets! We've never sold out so quickly!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Alright everyone, listen up! I've got some exciting news to share!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This piece of paper in my hand could be your ticket to an incredible seafaring adventure! Just think about the cool breeze, the spruced-up cruise ship, and the awesome music!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What more could you ask for? This is a once-in-a-lifetime chance for a trip you'll never forget!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So, let's get buzzing! Throw your hands in the air and your coins out of your pockets, and let your dreams come to life!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Let's hear those coins jingle and feel your spirits soar!

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: Woo-hoo!
The cheering grows louder and louder.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Is she a local? Australians are known for their sunny disposition.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: No one knows her, Miss. But, to be honest, I'd love to invite her to join the crew. If only the captain weren't so picky with the new recruits.
She nods approvingly at the freely dancing figure and clutches her Crackling Box tighter to her chest.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: I know what you mean. Her enthusiasm is infectious. Maybe her energy would wake up our stuffy new captain!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: I'll never understand why the captain fired the old crew and hired a load of people who don't seem to have any clue about music. All they do is make noise, and not the good kind either!
Several startled gazes land on Barcarola.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Shh. We better keep it down, Miss. They'll hear us.
He turns, peeking in the direction of the ship before awkwardly retracting his neck.

items.speaker: Quick-Minded Crew Member
items.text: We didn't hear any dissenting opinions about our captain, now, did we?

items.speaker: Concerned Crew Member
items.text: No, of course not!
The crew members glance at each other awkwardly, coughing softly to urge the embarrassing moment to pass quickly.
Guests come and go, and the melodies continue one after another.
Eventually, the sailaway party comes to an end.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, if I may, perhaps it's time we made our way to Laplace?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Come on, Mr. APPLe! The crowd's going crazy for us! Can't you see how close we are to winning that free ticket?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I suppose you're right, Captain. But the crew seems to be packing up for the day.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: THEY WHAT?!
Regulus quickly intercepts the cruise team before they can make their way back on the ship.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Oh. Can I help you? I'm afraid Ms. Barcarola won't be signing any more albums today.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What about my free ticket?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wasn't I the most enthusiastic guest tonight?

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Sorry, Miss, but the "most enthusiastic guest" was really just a turn of phrase.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: We're nearly sold out tonight, and bookings are still coming in. I don't think we can spare a ticket for you. Come by next time, and we'll see what we can do.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You—

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Easy, Captain! They never really explained what they meant by the "most enthusiastic guest." We're in no position to argue.
Regulus glances around. The once-bustling crowd has dwindled to just a few scattered passersby.
Clearly, there is no one present to uphold justice for her.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What a bloody scam! I'm filing a complaint! Just you wait and see!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: I understand your frustration, Miss. The ship is sailing in just a couple of days. Even if you file a complaint right at this moment, we won't hear a thing from the Tourist Office before we set sail.
Barcarola frowns and pulls the crewman aside.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: I feel bad for her, Mr. Hamish. And just think how this will affect our reputation. With your consent, I'd like to offer this young lady a ticket and a stay in my cabin.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: I'll be more than happy to pay for her!

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: You've done this so many times, Ms. Barcarola.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: I'm afraid I have to turn you down. You know the new captain won't exactly be thrilled to have a freeloader on the ship.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: But ...
Regulus barges between the two muttering colleagues.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So, how much longer do you need to think up an excuse?

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: Ugh, alright. In view of your outstanding enthusiasm, we offer you a special gift for your help with our event.

items.speaker: Cruise Ticket Seller
items.text: There. Thanks for your support.
A stack of "souvenirs" is thrust into Regulus's arms. Dejected, she turns to leave.
Barcarola pulls out a marker and cries out after her.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Wait!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: I'm so sorry about all this, Miss. I hope this will compensate for it.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh?

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: I hope we can see each other again. Preferably soon.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?!
